740.canonical: Delay summative judgment until formative revision is complete and the instruction meets design standards, then test — with an independent evaluator where one is available and qualified — whether it resolved the original problem, transferred to the intended setting, and delivers value across the intended contexts.

753.canonical: Teach motor and psychomotor skills through visual demonstration of the movement sequence and its timing, part-to-whole integration for complex performance, and repeated physical practice with immediate corrective feedback, so learners can calibrate force, timing, coordination, and movement accuracy.

758.canonical: Begin performance improvement without presuming instruction: observe the actual setting, consult frontline practitioners, and use proportionate front-end analysis to distinguish capability deficits from accountability, incentive, tool, time, support, resource, workflow, process, culture, and implementation causes.

868.canonical: Compress rare or slowly occurring real-world experience into simulated job-realistic scenarios and deliberately ordered cases, because the workplace delivers such problems too rarely and in no order of complexity — in one reported comparison, twenty to twenty-five hours in a coached troubleshooting environment matched four years on the job.
